diagnosis: TenantAnalyticsReportView uses OrganizationRateThrottle to enforce rate limits per organization. In OrganizationRateThrottle.get_cache_key(), the throttle bucket key is built from the client-controlled X-Tenant-Slug header without verifying that request.user belongs to that tenant organization. An attacker can pass a victim organization's slug to burn through their rate limit allowance or switch headers arbitrarily to evade throttle limits entirely.
exploit_request:
GET /api/reports/analytics/ HTTP/1.1
Host: platform.metricstream.io
Authorization: Token 44a3b2c1...
X-Tenant-Slug: acme-corp
Accept: application/json
